remarks:
Welcome to this exceptional Thomas Johnson built home offering over 3,500 square feet of pristine craftsmanship and luxurious design. Step inside to a grand two-story foyer featuring classic marble flooring that sets an elegant tone. The main level boasts a convenient first-floor laundry room, and a rare main-floor guest bedroom complete with an adjacent full bathroom, ideal for visitors or multi-generational living. At the heart of the home sits an expansive granite kitchen paired with a sun-drenched morning room, which opens seamlessly to a bright two-story family room anchored by a cozy gas fireplace.

Upstairs and down, this spacious property includes 5 large bedrooms and 4 full bathrooms, culminating in an impressive finished basement featuring a built-in wet bar designed for top-tier entertaining. Outside, enjoy a custom stamped-concrete patio and a massive 3.5-car garage offering endless room for vehicles and extra storage.

This home delivers total peace of mind with major mechanical updates, including a brand-new furnace and central air conditioning installed in 2026, a 50-gallon hot water tank added in 2024, an integrated security system, and a roof that is just 10 years young featuring premium 50-year architectural shingles. Offers will be reviewed as receive. Square footage measured by agent and included bonus room on 2nd floor. Square footage does not include the finished basement.
